name: OpenClaw
description: OpenClaw is a local AI agent platform that enables you to create, manage, and orchestrate AI agents across multiple channels like WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and Slack. Built on Node.js with extensible skills and workspace management, OpenClaw provides a powerful gateway for deploying AI-powered automations with support for multiple AI providers including OpenRouter, Anthropic, and OpenAI.

notes.text: Run `openclaw onboard` inside the container to complete the setup wizard and configure the gateway.
The wizard will guide you through AI provider setup (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI), gateway auth, and channel configuration.
Once configured, start the gateway with `openclaw gateway` and access the Control UI from your browser.
